en-US.author: Tashfeen Ahmed
en-US.description: Local OpenAI-compatible router that aggregates free LLM providers.
en-US.installationNotes: Open the app, then copy the unified API key shown in the tray popover and add your provider keys on the Keys page before pointing a client at the local /v1 endpoint.
en-US.longDescription:
FreeLLMAPI aggregates the free tiers of dozens of LLM providers, plus custom OpenAI-compatible chat, embedding, image, and audio endpoints, behind a single /v1 API.

A router picks the best available model for each request, falls over to the next provider when one is rate-limited, and tracks per-key usage so you stay under every free-tier cap. Provider keys are stored encrypted, and the router refreshes its model catalog from a signed feed. Built for personal use only; each provider's terms of service apply.
en-US.name: FreeLLMAPI
en-US.releaseNotes:
FreeTTS: local personal BYOK speech
- Add FreeTTS key setup and import support for your own local account.
- Add native MP3 text-to-speech with voice selection, fixed-host credential-safe downloads, bounded responses, audio validation and rate-limit failover.
- Keep the provider's spoken watermark. FreeTTS Free is personal/non-commercial; local use does not waive its terms or permit reselling shared API access.
- The signed catalog adds one logical TTS entry, neural-tts. Voices are parameters, not thousands of separate models. Premium receives the catalog entry now; Free receives it after the existing 30-day aging rule. No gate changes or early model seeding.
- Keep every other provider/model row, Mistral settings, and existing user overrides unchanged.
Install this release to use the FreeTTS adapter. Add your own FreeTTS key locally; no provider key is bundled or published.
The release also includes the fixes already merged on main since v0.16.24, including Gemini schema compatibility, overloaded-model sibling-key fallback, and the Start on system startup toggle.
Linux installer builds are pinned to Ubuntu 24.04 for compatibility with the current packaging tools; AppImage, tar.xz, DEB and RPM remain available.
Provider details: https://freetts.org/developers · https://freetts.org/pricing · https://freetts.org/terms

zh-CN.description: 聚合多家免费大模型服务的本地 OpenAI 兼容路由。
zh-CN.installationNotes: 打开应用后，从系统托盘气泡中复制统一 API 密钥，并在 Keys 页面添加服务商密钥，再将客户端指向本地的 /v1 接口。
zh-CN.longDescription:
FreeLLMAPI 将数十家大模型服务商的免费额度，以及自定义的 OpenAI 兼容对话、向量、图像和音频接口，聚合在同一个 /v1 API 之后。

路由器会为每个请求选择当前可用的最佳模型，当某个服务商被限流时自动切换到下一个，并统计每个密钥的用量以保持在免费额度之内。服务商密钥以加密方式存储，模型目录通过签名订阅源更新。仅面向个人使用，请遵守各服务商的服务条款。
